description:
• Brand introduction:

northstar collective is a lifestyle streetwear brand built on the values of hard work, grit, and sacrifice. we believe in embracing one’s true passion and turning it into a lifestyle. our mission is to inspire creators to pursue their northstar—their ultimate goal—while providing comfortable and versatile clothing that reflects their individuality.


• Product description:

our collection features high-quality streetwear designed for comfort and versatility. each piece combines simple yet eccentric designs that resonate with the creative spirit. whether you’re at the studio, on the go, or out with friends, our clothing is crafted to elevate your style and empower your journey. 


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

our unique selling point lies in our commitment to authenticity and community. we focus on creating a supportive environment for creators, offering not just clothing but a lifestyle that encourages self-expression and the pursuit of dreams. every purchase supports our goal of creating job opportunities for designers and artists within our community. 


• Payment terms:

affiliates will earn a competitive commission on each sale generated through their unique referral link starting at minimum of 10% per order with a ranking system. payments will be processed bi-weekly, with a minimum payout threshold of $50. affiliates will receive detailed reporting on their performance and commissions through our affiliate dashboard

 
• Other information:

we’re looking for passionate individuals who resonate with our brand values and are excited to promote our mission. affiliates will have access to exclusive promotions, sneak peeks of new collections, and the opportunity to participate in our community events. join us in inspiring others to chase their NorthStar!

You will be given copy and paste text messages and video ideas to help increase your sales for a win win situation.
name: NorthStar Co
